title: Project introduction
description: How EdgePress is structured, why it uses zero runtime dependencies, and what runtimes it supports.

cells.title: A zero-dependency static site builder.
cells.text: EdgePress keeps content, themes, and build scripts separate so you know exactly which file to edit when you want to change text, layout, or deployment settings.

items.title: Pages (content/pages/)
items.text: Store page metadata, row column counts, and ordered blocks in one JSON file per language.

items.title: Posts (content/posts/)
items.text: Write articles in Markdown. The built-in parser renders HTML and strips unsafe tags.

items.title: Themes (themes/)
items.text: Keep HTML layouts, shared header/footer partials, and CSS palettes in one place.
